svg.text: Exercise 2. Three resistors, one at a time
220 Ω, 1 kohm, 10 kohm: the same LED, three currents

polyline.data-label: each LED back to the - rail

svg.text: each LED back to the - rail
1. Pack at the left. Three branches in row c, left to right: 220 Ω, 1K Ω, 10K Ω.
2. A resistor from column 4 to 8, then 10 to 14, then 16 to 20.
3. LEDs in columns 8 and 9, 14 and 15, 20 and 21: long leg toward the resistor.
4. Red jumpers: the + rail to each resistor's left leg. Black jumpers: each LED back to the - rail.
5. Red lead on the + rail, black lead on the - rail. Bright, dimmer, barely on: same LED, three currents.
Each branch has its own resistor and LED, so you can compare them without rebuilding.
The LED is a current device: the resistor is what decides how much current it gets.
